_comment: One trial was removed rather than fixed: 'a load failure is reported as a successful load of nothing', which mutated the non-Image arm of load_into_kernel's byte source. A load walks STRUCTURE and never content, so that arm is unreachable during a load and the mutant changes nothing observable -- the same class as sm_alloc's max(len,1). The reason is recorded at the arm itself so nobody re-adds it.
